ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a simple food chain. At the bottom is an organism labeled “Phytoplankton.” An arrow points upward from phytoplankton to an organism labeled “Krill.” Another arrow points upward from krill to a large animal labeled “Baleen whale.” Reasoning: In a food chain, the producer is the organism at the base that makes its own food, usually by photosynthesis. Since phytoplankton is at the bottom of this chain and is photosynthetic, the producer is phytoplankton.
